provenance.source: PR #12596 fix/clarify-scope-error, merged 2026-03-02; reverted by PR #12915
provenance.note: INTRODUCED: the PR adds the interception in handleResponse, which now returns the reformatted scope error for any INSUFFICIENT_SCOPES GraphQL error, before GraphQLError/ProjectsV2IgnorableError can match the server's own wording and let the command degrade; gh pr view and gh issue view fail outright when the token lacks read:project (issue #12904), and PR #12915 reverts this change. The base passes the original ghAPI.GraphQLError through, whose message still carries the wording ProjectsV2IgnorableError matches, so the defect is new here

keywords: fails the command instead of degrading
turns an ignorable scope failure into a fatal error
the caller never sees the partial result
a missing project scope aborts the whole command
a response that also carries usable data is thrown away
the command aborts even though only one field of the query failed
bugs.note: the interception returns its own error before the caller can decide the failed field is ignorable, so a query that also returned usable data fails
